title: tba-to-oauth2 inventory
description: docs/tba-to-oauth2-inventory.json: every NetSuite authentication site found in a repo, grouped into integrations. Paths are relative to the repo root with forward slashes; lines are 1-based and follow detection-patterns.md section 6. Never put a credential value in this file: names and locations only.

excluded.description: Candidates that were read and rejected: look-alikes, generic helpers, vendored or generated code, NetSuite-side SuiteScript (detection-patterns.md section 8).

outsideRepo.description: Integrations that may authenticate to the account from outside this repo (iPaaS, vendor connectors, other teams' code), each with the clue that suggests it. Confirm with the Login Audit Trail recipe in the plan.

file.description: Repo-relative path, forward slashes, no leading ./ or /.

id.description: Short kebab-case id, unique in the file.

name.description: What it is and where it lives, e.g. 'Nightly AR export (jobs/nightly_ar_export.py)'.

outcome.description: detection-patterns.md section 7. An IssueToken integration takes m2m or auth-code-pkce, like other TBA.

attended.description: true when a person is present when it runs.

endpoints.description: NetSuite endpoints it calls, account ID replaced by <account>, e.g. 'RESTlet script=customscript_x deploy=1', '/services/rest/query/v1/suiteql', 'SOAP NetSuitePort_2023_1'.

role.description: The role the OAuth 2.0 replacement needs: the documented permission (roles.md) plus what its calls need, which is not measured. Name the role the code or config shows, if any; never an internal ID from a live account.

name.description: The key or variable name, never the value.
